statements.text: I think that the scariest thing about AI from a capability standpoint is it does not have to be a state actor to win this race. It is not like nuclear energy. It is not like space technology. A nonstate actor could just as easily win this race and wield more power than anyone else.
statements.context: Senate hearing titled 'Winning the AI Race: Strengthening U.S. Capabilities in Computing and Innovation,' Senator Sheehy questioning industry witnesses including Sam Altman.
